_comment: Externalized PDP policy (this hardening revision -- see docs/HARDENING.md). Editing this file and calling pdp.policy_engine.reload_policies() (or restarting the Gateway) changes enforced policy WITHOUT touching pdp/policy_engine.py. Falls back to common.config.RESOURCES for any resource/field not present here.

finance-app._max_auth_age_note: Step-up: the user must have authenticated within the last 5 minutes to reach this high-sensitivity resource, regardless of whether their token is still unexpired. Set to null or remove to disable. See pdp/policy_engine.py.
finance-app._required_amr_note: Authentication methods this resource demands. Add "device" to require a cryptographically attested device login, not merely password+OTP.
